description: A citation is checked against the exact passages this request supplied, so an id from anywhere else -- invented, guessed, or belonging to another workspace -- is refused. The handler's passage set comes from a facade reading under the workspace query filter, so a neighbour's passage is never in it; this proves that an id outside the set cannot be cited even so. The refusal never echoes the id: one this request did not offer is not this workspace's to confirm.

passages.text: We write like a friend who happens to cook.
